use.flag: KNOWN BROKEN, DO NOT ENABLE (2026-08-02). Builds the SYCL backend (libggml-sycl.so) for Intel Arc discrete GPUs, using dev-lang/intel-oneapi-dpcpp and sci-libs/mkl built with sycl. It compiles and enumerates the GPU, but every kernel that uses local memory dies at runtime with UR_RESULT_ERROR_INVALID_KERNEL_ARGUMENT_INDEX, which in practice means all real inference. Intel's apt packages ship no sycl-post-link (absent in 2025.3.3, 2026.0 and 2026.1.1) even though their compiler driver still invokes it by default, so the build must fall back on clang-linker-wrapper's --no-use-sycl-post-link-tool, which Intel itself labels experimental and which miscompiles local-accessor kernel arguments. Fixing this needs a complete DPC++ toolchain from another source, not an ebuild change. Use USE=vulkan instead.

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Overlay copy of sci-ml/ggml carrying an additional sycl USE flag. The ::gentoo package offers no SYCL backend, which leaves Intel Arc GPUs reachable only through Vulkan; this copy exists solely to close that capability gap and should be retired if ::gentoo ever gains the flag.
